opening_message: Hi — please add the SoundMax Wireless Headphones and the SoundMax Beat Pro Wireless Speaker to my cart. Gift wrap the speaker please.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are a returning customer buying two SoundMax items. You want the speaker gift-wrapped, the headphones not wrapped. You will NOT ask about brand discounts, loyalty points, gift wrap fees, or any other benefits — you assume the agent will mention anything relevant.
known_info: You want one SoundMax Wireless Headphones (SP-2003), no gift wrap.
You want one SoundMax Beat Pro Wireless Speaker (SP-2009), WITH gift wrap.
task_rules: Your goal is to add one SoundMax Wireless Headphones (SP-2003) with no gift wrap and one SoundMax Beat Pro Wireless Speaker (SP-2009) with gift wrap, without starting checkout or any unrelated cart, promo, loyalty-redemption, or shipping action.
If the agent asks for account lookup details, provide only the requested identity detail from your profile; do not volunteer that you are Platinum, returning, or interested in any benefits.
If the agent asks about item details or wrap settings, confirm that the headphones should not be wrapped and the speaker should be wrapped.
Do not ask about brand discounts, loyalty points earned, gift-wrap fees, promos, category bundles, or other benefits, even if the agent has not mentioned them.
When the agent proactively mentions the same-brand bundle, loyalty points earned, or the gift-wrap fee, acknowledge the information briefly but do not ask about any missing disclosure.
If the agent gives a cart summary with only some or none of those policy details, accept the summary as long as the two requested items and the speaker gift wrap are correct.

Push back if the agent omits either requested item, wraps the headphones, fails to wrap the speaker, changes quantities, substitutes a different product, or proposes an out-of-scope write such as checkout, shipping selection, promo application, or loyalty-point redemption.

End only after both requested SoundMax items are in the cart with the correct gift-wrap settings and the agent has provided a final cart summary; do not wait for missing policy disclosures before using [TASK_DONE].
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Platinum customer (shop_001) adds two SoundMax items: SP-2003 SoundMax Wireless Headphones ($149, no wrap) + SP-2009 SoundMax Beat Pro Wireless Speaker ($349, gift wrap requested). Three policies apply silently: brand_bundle (2+ same-brand → 3% bonus, ~$15), loyalty_points (Platinum = 3 pts/$, ~1500 pts), gift_wrap ($5 fee per wrapped item).

**Challenge:** Tests compound proactive disclosure across THREE unrelated policies. Pitfall: agent handles the adds + wrap mechanically, surfaces maybe one of the three policies (gift wrap fee is most likely since it's directly relevant to the wrap ask), and forgets brand bundle + loyalty. Customer is silent on all three topics. Correct: agent calls get_customer_account (sees Platinum), consults brand_bundle + loyalty_points + gift_wrap policies, and reports all three at cart summary with specific numbers.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent called get_customer_account for shop_001 to determine tier (Platinum) before discussing pricing or benefits.

Agent proactively mentioned the SAME-brand bundle bonus (3% off qualifying items, ~$15) because both SoundMax items qualify. Generic 'you may get a discount' without naming the brand-bundle policy or a number fails.

Agent proactively mentioned loyalty points earned with a specific number (~1500 pts) using the Platinum rate (3 pts/$). Wrong rate (1 or 2 pts/$) fails. Generic 'you'll earn points' without a number fails.
Agent proactively mentioned that gift wrap costs $5 per item BEFORE or AT the cart summary. Silently adding gift_wrap=True without naming the fee fails.
Agent added SP-2003 with gift_wrap=False and SP-2009 with gift_wrap=True, quantity 1 each.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
